title: Exotic Peruvian Ti-Leaf Wrap
description: A flavorful and fresh dish featuring tender chicken in aji amarillo pepper sauce, wrapped in a crunchy ti-leaf.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together aji amarillo pepper sauce, rice vinegar, and yuzu juice.
Add the aji amarillo mixture to the braised chicken and toss to coat.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until lightly browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the ti-leaf leaves by tearing them into large pieces and placing them on a plate.
To assemble the wraps, place a spoonful of the chicken mixture onto the center of a ti-leaf leaf.
Add a sprinkle of chopped cilantro and a drizzle of ayurvedic ghee on top.
Fold the bottom half of the ti-leaf leaf up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Repeat with the remaining chicken mixture and ti-leaf leaves.
